sentences.en: Daddy told me where it would be nice to go.
sentences.zh: 爸爸告诉我去哪儿会比较好。

sentences.en: Daddy must be able to cook at least one egg!
sentences.zh: 爸爸至少得会做一只鸡蛋吧！

sentences.en: When was the last time you came to visit daddy?
sentences.zh: 你上次来看爸爸是什么时候？

phrases.zh: 金主（通常指资助年轻女子的有钱男人）

senses.zh: 爸爸,爹,甜心爸爸（在年轻女子身上乱花钱的阔老头）,老色鬼
